findings.title: The garden-entry saying interrupts self-attribution
findings.claim: At the threshold of entering the garden, the saying that attributes what is present to Allah makes the owner's relation to visible abundance an act of attribution rather than a silent claim of self-owned power.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is the spoken-utterance sense of qwl at 18:39:5. The supplied 7:188 parallel joins the utterance formula to the denial of independent benefit, while 68:28 joins a garden scene to a reproach over the missing glorifying utterance. Their contact returns through the focus saying and makes its timing before comparison semantically active.
findings.reader_payoff: The formula becomes perceptible as a threshold intervention: it names dependence before the garden's visible abundance can harden into self-credit.
findings.containment: The ordinary instruction to say what Allah wills and that power is through Allah remains intact. This finding does not claim that the utterance mechanically preserves the garden or that every use of qwl carries this intervention.

epistemic.reason: The retained cross-run support is trusted and focus-anchored; the two wider connection rows supply exact target Arabic for the independent contextual triggers, while the interpretation remains bounded to this contact.

findings.title: Power is received capacity
findings.claim: The focus's denial of independent power presents capacity as received and dependent rather than as a self-contained quantity possessed by the garden owner.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is qwy at 18:39:10. The supplied wider passages join provision and willing to divine strength at 42:19, name Allah as Provider and possessor of strength at 51:58, affirm divine strength at 22:74, and deny strength or a helper at 86:10. These independent contacts return to the focus power term and make its source relation materially visible.
findings.reader_payoff: Power is newly perceptible as enabled capacity: the garden owner's visible means remain means, while effective strength is attributed beyond the owner.
findings.containment: The finding does not deny human action, bodily strength, material means, or helpers. It preserves the focus's ordinary restriction and does not claim that every wider use of strength has the same local force.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus-anchored finding is reinforced by exact wider Arabic connection targets; the claim is limited to the source-and-capacity relation that returns through 18:39:10.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider exact passages separately couple provision or willing with divine strength and explicitly remove autonomous strength or a helper.
branch_activations.activation: The source-and-capacity relation in those passages contacts the focus restriction, so qwy's power is read as effective capacity whose source is not the owner himself.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The garden owner's apparent power is an enabled capacity rather than an independently held reserve.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation keeps ordinary human and material means in view and does not turn the wider parallels into a universal lexical rule.

findings.title: Visible capacity can come apart
findings.claim: The wider garden-loss pattern makes the focus's power legible as a composite of supports whose visible integrity can be separated rather than as an indivisible personal possession.
findings.mechanism: The qwy carrier is contacted by the supplied retrospective sequence of 18:40-43, which names ground, water, structure, and faction as supports removed in turn, and by exact wider garden-loss scenes at 2:266, 34:16, 68:19, and 28:81. The core power facet and its rope specialization therefore meet an independent image of assembled capacity being dismantled.
findings.reader_payoff: The restriction on power acquires a concrete shape: apparent capacity can be taken apart strand by strand as its supports fail.
findings.containment: This is a qualified contextual resonance. It does not replace the ordinary force sense, claim that every garden loss follows the same sequence, or turn the rope image into a literal description of the owner's resources.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective walk evidence is legacy-unbound, while the wider target rows supply exact Arabic for the independent loss contacts; the finding keeps both the support-set mechanism and its provenance limitation visible.

findings.title: Wealth and offspring become a questioned status metric
findings.claim: The focus's comparison in wealth and offspring is globally reframed as a socially countable measure of standing whose apparent quantity can be provisioned, rivalled, tested, or rendered useless.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers are the ordinary wealth and offspring senses at 18:39:18 and 18:39:19. The supplied wider passages pair wealth and children with confident future possession at 19:77, rivalry and fading growth at 57:20, trial at 64:15, refusal of material avail at 69:28, and the posture of seeing oneself self-sufficient at 96:7. Their repeated return through the focus comparison changes it from a bare inventory into exposure of the metric being used.
findings.reader_payoff: The final comparison is newly perceptible as a value claim under scrutiny: the quantities remain real, yet their count does not settle worth, security, or independent efficacy.
findings.containment: The ordinary comparison of amounts and children remains recoverable. This finding does not deny material difference or import every moral implication of the wider passages into 18:39.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies exact target Arabic and valid focus carriers, but the connection rows do not supply target morphology or an independent lexicon crosswalk; the status therefore marks a bounded global inference rather than a lexical proof.
